shortDescription: ANCHORAGE, Alaska, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- At the First National Bank Alaska Board of Directors meeting held Oct. 29, 2026, a cash dividend of $4.00 per share was declared, payable on Dec. 15, 2026, to shareholders of record as of Dec. 1, 2026.At the same meeting, the Board also declared…

children: -- At the First National Bank Alaska Board of Directors meeting held Oct. 29, 2026, a cash dividend of $4.00 per share was declared, payable on Dec. 15, 2026, to shareholders of record as of Dec. 1, 2026.
At the same meeting, the Board also declared a special cash dividend of $4.00 per share, payable on Dec. 10, 2026, to shareholders of record as of Dec. 1, 2026.
Secretary to the Board of Directors

title: First National Bank Alaska declares regular and special dividends for fourth quarter 2026, both payable in December
